fact: QMD (Quick Markdown) - Local search engine for markdown documents combining BM25 full-text search, vector semantic search, and LLM re-ranking
Repository: https://github.com/tobi/qmd - Open source project by tobi
Installation method: Bun global install via 'bun install -g https://github.com/tobi/qmd'
Features: Collection management, keyword search, semantic search, hybrid search, document retrieval, MCP server support
QMD skill for Clawdbot: https://github.com/levineam/qmd-skill - Enables AI agents to search markdown knowledge bases
